name: cooling_coil_refsim
title: Cooling coil RefSim model, dry and wet regimes (one zone)
summary: Reference simulation model of a cooling and dehumidifying coil from the ULiège model bank: a one-zone counter-flow exchanger in which the fully dry and the fully wet regimes are described simultaneously and the regime of largest capacity is kept (Braun hypothesis); AU is the series of the air-side, metal and refrigerant-side resistances, the wet regime uses a fictitious perfect gas at the wet-bulb temperature and a fictitious semi-isothermal contact surface, and the secondary refrigerant properties come from the BrineProp library.

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), cooling coil reference simulation model, 2008-01-16; published as Lemort, Cuevas, Lebrun, Teodorese, ASHRAE Transactions 114(1), 2008

verification.reference: EES stored solution in the source file (87 decoded variables) against the runnable variant cooling_coil_refsim_coolsolve.eescode; the native file cannot be solved (CS-GAP-NAME-PIPE, CS-GAP-INCLUDE, CS-GAP-IF5, CS-GAP-IFSTR)
verification.notes: 74 common variables, 21 differ above rtol=0.001, maximum relative difference 7.81e-01 (DELTA_t_cond, 10.107 K against 2.218 K). Cause: the stored EES value of t_dp_ex_coil_dry (4.28e-01) is stale and inconsistent with the equation W_ex_coil_dry = W_su_coil of the file itself (it equals t_a_ex_coil_dry exactly, while the dew point of W_su_coil = 0.0137708 kg/kg at 98000 Pa is 18.4 °C, the value stored for the identical supply call t_dp_su_coil = 18.442 °C); DELTA_t_cond is its only user. The 19 remaining deviations (1.2e-03 to 4.8e-03) come from the EES and CoolProp humid-air formulations (W_su_coil 4.64e-03, h_a_su_coil 2.14e-03, W_c_coil_wet and W_ex_coil 4.79e-03), as in the other humid-air models of the library (CSL-0070 4.4e-03, CSL-0016 5.1e-03). The algebraic results are reproduced to 7.9e-04 or better (resistances exact, epsilon_c_coil_wet 9.4e-06, RH_ex_coil 6.8e-06, t_a_ex_coil_dry 1.0e-04). No variable excluded; three variables only the variant has (the renamed Kstar_r, Kstar_r_n and the string input refrigerant$), one decoded EES variable (LAT) is not a variable of the model.
